title: Father wins P21.69M lotto jackpot using Lucky Pick numbers
summary: A longtime lotto player won the P21.69-million jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office"s (PCSO) Lotto 6/42 draw on October 29, 2026, after placing a Lucky Pick bet.

blocks.text: A longtime lotto player won the P21.69-million jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office’s (PCSO) Lotto 6/42 draw on October 29, 2026, after placing a Lucky Pick bet.
The winner claimed his prize of P21,694,699.03 at the PCSO main office in Mandaluyong City on November 3.
He correctly matched the winning combination 34-15-19-37-25-38.

The winner, a father currently renting a house with his children, recalled discovering his win only when he returned to the lotto outlet the following day to place another bet. Upon seeing the winning numbers posted, his knees began to tremble as he realized he had hit the jackpot.
Still in disbelief, he managed to remain composed, saying the reality of his life-changing win only sank in when he arrived home.
He said he plans to use his newfound fortune to improve their living conditions and start a business that would provide them with a more stable future.
The PCSO reminded jackpot winners to immediately sign the back of their winning tickets and claim their prizes within one year from the date of the draw.
Under the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law, lotto winnings exceeding P10,000 are subject to a 20% final tax.
Proceeds from lotto ticket sales help fund its various charitable programs, including medical assistance, health services, and other initiatives for Filipinos in need.
The lotto 6/42 draws are held every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at 9:00 p.m., and are broadcast live on IBC-13, D8TV, and the PCSO Games Online Hub Facebook page.
